subject: [AMBER] Implicit solvent MD for membrane proteins

messages.author: Ravi Abrol
messages.body:
Hi,
Is there a way/example to use pmemd for implicit solvent dynamics of
membrane proteins in amber,
using a 3-slab or a 5-slab membrane model?
If not, are there potential alternatives anyone can recommend?
Thanks,
Ravi

messages.author: Ravi Abrol
messages.body:
Pinging again, hoping to get a response or a pointer in the right direction.
Thanks,
Ravi
